answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a refundable stake that serves as an anchor to real capital before it can transact. Minting a fresh identity then costs as much as cracking a walnut by hand, so a sybil flood must fund a canyon-sized pile of bonds. Honest agents recover their stake with yield from verified work, while agents caught colluding are slashed, so an attacker's cost climbs linearly with each fake identity while genuine returns stay positive.
